data.intent: Understand how LLMs relate to neural networks and what distinguishes them.

questions: How are neural networks and LLMs related conceptually, and what makes an LLM a particular kind of neural network rather than a separate technology?
What architectural features commonly distinguish modern LLMs—such as transformer layers and attention—from other neural-network architectures?
How do LLM training data and objectives differ from those used to train neural networks for tasks such as classification, vision, or control?
How do scale, compute requirements, and deployment demands typically differ between LLMs and other neural networks, and how much do these differences depend on the application?
What capabilities and limitations distinguish LLMs from other neural networks, including what they can do at inference time and what they do not inherently understand or guarantee?
